Body holds six full-tile pointer tensors (q_in_20, k_val_62, v_val_64, and %1/%3/%5 = q/k/v_ptr+out_off, each tensor<32x4x16x!tt.ptr<f16>> = 8 B/element), plus out_off_42 i32 and the fp32 q opmath chain (extf/addf/mulf/truncf). Address arithmetic, not payload data, dominates the UB estimate; the earlier byte-based tile budget did not control it.

The EXACT (unmasked) specialization has the same 6-pointer-tensor structure (tile 8/4/16 = 512 elements, num_head_groups/stride_qkv_d/stride_bias dead-argument-eliminated). So the overflow is not caused by the mask tensors nor by the EXACT/masked split; it tracks tile element count and live full-tile pointer tensors.

Lines 124-145 / 152-173 load q, k and v and only then store all three, so all three payload tiles, all three fp32/intermediate results and all six pointer tensors are simultaneously live. Lines 26-52 comment claims 8192 B keeps ~139 KiB; the IR above shows the realized tile was 2048 elements and still needed 268288 B, so the byte model under-counts per-element address bytes (~131 B/element effective).

Repair must stay inside the existing hypothesis (one affine [BLOCK_S, BLOCK_H, BLOCK_D] tile per (batch, head_group, seq_block) program, adjacent heads grouped for wider contiguous input rows, no per-element index decoding). current_profiling/current_simulator are null: no profiling or simulator evidence exists for this source.

hypothesis: The UB requirement is driven by tile ELEMENT count times the number of simultaneously live full-tile tensors, chiefly 8 B/element pointer tensors (effective ~131 B/element for f16 at 2048 elements). Two focused levers inside the same tile hypothesis: (1) lower the element budget so an f16 program never exceeds ~1024 elements (2048 B / element-size), and (2) make the three components sequential phases (load+compute+store q, then k, then v) so only one input and one output pointer tensor is live at a time instead of six. Combined forecast ~100 B/element * 1024 = ~100 KiB, comfortably under 196608 B.
change: candidate.py only: _TILE_BYTES 8192 -> 2048; _MIN_STORE_BYTES 2048 -> 1024 so BLOCK_H=2 head grouping survives the smaller budget (for head_dim=64 fp16: BLOCK_S=8, BLOCK_H=2, BLOCK_D=64 = 1024 elements, 128 contiguous input columns per row; previously 16x2x64 = 2048). Kernel body restructured in both EXACT and masked branches into three sequential q -> k -> v phases; masks, affine (s,h,d) indexing, generic stride handling, fp32 q opmath + input-dtype k/v adds, and the host-side tile selection logic otherwise unchanged.
